items.summary: India has initiated the Airship-based High Altitude Pseudo Satellite (AS-HAPS) programme for indigenous stratospheric airships designed for long-endurance surveillance…
items.numbers: These platforms remain below low-Earth orbit satellites, which generally operate between 500 km and 2,000 km, and above many high-altitude drones that fly at around 12 km.

items.title: CSIR celebrates women researchers through ASPIRE-SHAKTI initiative
items.summary: The Council of Scientific & Industrial Research (CSIR) organised ASPIRE-SHAKTI, titled “Celebrating Women in STEM & Initiating Project Review Sessions”, on 13…
items.numbers: Jitendra Singh, Union Minister of Science & Technology, and launched on International Women’s Day in 2023.

items.title: All India Water Secretaries’ Conference Held in New Delhi
items.summary: The All India Water Secretaries’ Conference was held in New Delhi on 13 and 14 July 2026 under the Ministry of Jal Shakti.
items.numbers: The topics included water conservation, dam safety, irrigation reforms, groundwater management, and the Catch the Rain 2026 campaign.

items.title: Grey Hornbill returns to Gujarat’s Gir forests after six decades
items.summary: The Indian Grey Hornbill, also known as Chilotro, has been reintroduced into the Gir forests of Gujarat after an absence of more than six decades.
items.numbers: The reintroduction programme released 40 hornbills in two phases, with 28 birds in 2021-2022 and 12 birds in 2023.

items.title: Karnataka Announces India’s First Government-Driven AI University
items.summary: Karnataka announced a plan to establish India’s first government-driven Artificial Intelligence University on 14 July 2026.

items.title: India Launches SHANTI Campaign for UNSC Bid
items.summary: India launched its official campaign on 13 July 2026 for a non-permanent seat on the United Nations Security Council for the 2028-29 term. External Affairs Minister S.
items.numbers: The Asia-Pacific Group has one seat in the 2028-29 election cycle, and India will contest that seat against Tajikistan in elections scheduled for June 2027.

items.title: Two New Solitary Bee Species Discovered in Arunachal Pradesh
items.summary: Two new solitary bee species, Elaphropoda triangulata and Habropoda adi, were identified in Arunachal Pradesh on 11 July 2026.
items.numbers: Researchers from the Zoological Survey of India discovered another new solitary bee species, Ceratinatawangensis, in Tawang, Arunachal Pradesh, on 4 February 2026.

items.title: Daily Current Affairs Quiz: July 15, 2026
Nine European Countries and Ukraine Form Missile Defence Coalition
items.summary: On 13 July 2026, nine European countries and Ukraine formed an Integrated Anti-Ballistic Missile Coalition in Paris, France.

items.title: Index of Services Production
items.summary: The Government of India has introduced the Index of Services Production (ISP). This new macroeconomic indicator tracks the performance of the services sector.
items.numbers: The trial index for April 2026 covers 19 sub-sectors, representing roughly 60% of the services economy.

items.title: Draft National Health Research Policy 2026
items.summary: The Department of Health Research under the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare unveiled the Draft National Health Research Policy 2026 on 13-15 July 2026.
items.numbers: It proposes raising health research spending to 0.072% of GDP by 2037 and 0.15% of GDP by 2047.

items.title: India Announces Seafarer-First Maritime Safety Plan
items.summary: India announced the “Seafarer-First” emergency maritime safety plan on 15 July 2026 in New Delhi after attacks on the merchant vessels MT Al Bahiyah and MT Mombasa in…
items.numbers: The Directorate General of Shipping issued Circular 21 of 2026 on 10 April 2026 for Indian seafarers in the Middle East.

items.title: Delhi Approves Time-Bound Public Service Delivery Bill
items.summary: On July 14, 2026, the Delhi Cabinet approved the Delhi (Right of Citizen to Time Bound and Ease of Delivery of Services) Bill, 2026.
items.numbers: On June 23, 2026, the Delhi Government added 23 new services under the Delhi Right of Citizens to Time-Bound Delivery of Services Act, 2011.

items.title: Navi Mumbai International Airport Starts International Operations
items.summary: Navi Mumbai International Airport (NMIA) commenced scheduled international operations on 15 July 2026.
items.numbers: The airport began domestic operations on 25 December 2025, less than 200 days before the start of international services.

items.title: Wearable Ammonia Gas Sensor Developed by Indian Scientists
items.summary: Indian scientists developed a portable, self-powered and wearable ammonia sensing device on 14 July 2026.

items.title: CAC49 Adopts Seven Codex Standards Under India’s Leadership
items.summary: The 49th Session of the Codex Alimentarius Commission (CAC49) was held in Geneva, Switzerland, from 6 July to 10 July 2026.

items.title: Indian Railways launches Reform Express freight reforms
items.summary: Indian Railways announced eight structural freight reforms under the “Reform Express” initiative on 14 July 2026.
items.numbers: The earlier multi-category system has been replaced, and the registration fee has been fixed at ₹25 crore.

items.title: 31st Divya Kala Mela Inaugurated in Kolkata
items.summary: The 31st Divya Kala Mela was inaugurated on 14 July 2026 at Ravindra Sadan in Kolkata.
items.numbers: Union Minister for Social Justice and Empowerment Virendra Kumar inaugurated the eight-day event, which will continue till 22 July 2026.

items.title: Daily Current Affairs Quiz: July 17, 2026
Cyclospora Outbreak Sickens Thousands Across United States
items.summary: Cyclospora is a microscopic parasite that causes cyclosporiasis, a foodborne intestinal infection linked to contaminated fresh produce.
items.numbers: The 2026 outbreak includes a multi-state cluster of more than 400 cases in Michigan, Ohio, West Virginia, and Kentucky, with symptom onset generally reported on or after 22 June 2026.

items.title: Uttar Pradesh Launches Kaushal Setu and Kaushal Sarathi Portals
items.summary: Uttar Pradesh launched Kaushal Setu and Kaushal Sarathi on 15 July 2026 in Lucknow during the state-level celebration of World Youth Skills Day-2026 at Indira Gandhi…

items.title: New Monkey Species Discovered in Congo Rainforest
items.summary: A new monkey species, Colobus congoensis, has been identified in the Democratic Republic of Congo.
items.numbers: The estimated evolutionary divergence between the two species is 4 to 5 million years.

items.title: Government issues draft CAFE III norms
items.summary: The Government of India released the draft Corporate Average Fuel Economy (CAFE) III norms on 16 July 2026.
items.numbers: The target is 3.996 litres per 100 km, or 94.76 gCO₂/km, in 2027-28, and 3.3273 litres per 100 km, or 78.90 gCO₂/km, in 2031-32.

items.title: New damselfly species found in Kerala’s Western Ghats
items.summary: Researchers have recorded multiple new damselfly species from the Western Ghats of Kerala between 2023 and 2026.
items.numbers: Lestes paloti was discovered in July 2026 in Kerala’s Western Ghats and was published in the International Journal of Odonatology.

items.title: Centre Tightens ISRO Scientist Exit Rules
items.summary: The Department of Space issued an internal memorandum on 14 July 2026 to tighten rules for voluntary retirement and resignation of scientists associated with the Indian…
items.numbers: The new order reverses a 2020 administrative arrangement that allowed directors of individual ISRO centres to approve resignation and voluntary retirement requests.

items.title: Project INROAD Expands Natural Rubber Plantations in North-East
items.summary: Project INROAD, or Indian Natural Rubber Operations for Assisted Development, is a plantation expansion initiative for natural rubber in North-East India and West Bengal.
items.numbers: By 15-16 July 2026, the project had created 1.8 lakh hectares of new rubber plantations against a target of 2 lakh hectares across 113 districts.

items.title: Agnikul to Attempt Rocket Stage Recovery
items.summary: Agnikul Cosmos is preparing Mission 02, which is planned as India’s first private-sector attempt at orbital-class rocket reusability.
items.numbers: The company raised 17 million in November 2025 and was valued at 500 million during that funding round.

items.title: S. Somanath Joins Agnikul Cosmos Board
items.summary: S. Somanath, former Chairman of the Indian Space Research Organisation, has joined Chennai-based Agnikul Cosmos as an observer on its board of directors.
items.numbers: He served as ISRO Chairman from January 2022 to January 2025 and worked in India’s space programme for nearly 40 years.
